title: 第11章 底薪签约第12章 征战季前赛
content_zh:
第十一章 底薪签约
还没有签约，叶锋就已经和队友们混熟了，做记者的人往往擅长察言观色，会说别人喜欢听的话。叶锋很清楚几位主力球员的喜好。
费舍尔是个顾家的人，为了给女儿治病才从爵士买断合同回到了洛杉矶，叶锋和他聊天的时候喜欢围绕着家人的话题，把他当成老大哥看待。费舍尔的球技一般，不过他是湖人更衣室的领袖，除此以外，费舍尔还是球员工会的主席，全联盟球员都要给他面子。
和奥多姆聊天的时候，他大多是聊电影和好莱坞明星。奥多姆抽空会和他练习单挑，指导了一些进攻办法，让他受益匪浅。
拉德马诺维奇的爱好是滑雪，叶锋也滑过雪，两人这方面聊的很投机，还相约有空一起去滑，但一定不会是新赛季的全明星周末，叶锋记得前世拉德马诺维奇那时在滑雪中受伤，后被球队禁赛，损失超过50万美元，从此人送外号“滑雪男”。
NBA新人一直有帮老队员提包、服务的光荣传统。叶锋是菜鸟，又是边缘人，还是球队中年龄最小的人，他可不会狂妄到想要把这潜规则打破了。不用别人提醒他就主动献殷勤。他经常主动帮费舍尔、奥多姆两个老队友递毛巾，倒水，做些讨好的小事。费舍尔等人也都很喜欢他，把他当成小兄弟来看待。
这些事情，制服组也都看在了眼里。其他新人和叶锋相比腼腆的多，他们尊敬老队员，却不懂得怎么去讨好，和叶锋比落了下成。
加上早就混熟了的拜纳姆，湖人先发球员中有四人和叶锋关系良好，如果这些人肯美言几句，叶锋相信获得一份合同的可能性大增，他可不想再回UCLA上大学。
叶锋唯一没处好的人是科比。科比的脾气不像媒体说的那么糟糕，只是有点内向，不善言辞。他和队友们说话不多，喜欢在练习后一边做按摩，一边听音乐，非常安静。叶锋想和科比多说几句话，想来想去也找不到话题。
科比的心思都在篮球上，他和人相处不会露出虚伪的假笑，遇到不感兴趣的话题时不会接话，也许只有问他问题，他才会吭声。
不过，话说的少不代表科比讨厌叶锋，有天训练结束后，他也留下来练了一会儿投篮。在临走时对叶锋说：“你不能每个位置都中投准确，就先练高位一个点，只要你在高位可以投进中投，挡拆后就多了一种进攻手段。”
这么一句话就点醒了叶锋。从那天起，他从练习各个位置投篮变成了只练高位和罚球。这样有针对性的练习法，总算让他取得了一点进步。
季前赛明天就要开打了，拉芙林通知叶锋去见总经理库普切克，告诉他是个号消息。
库普切克让他坐在对面，笑道：“叶，你没有经济人，所以我就直接找你谈了，几位教练对你的表现进行了评估。你在进攻端很差，可是在防守方面比较出色，也很有拼劲。你每天都留下加练至少两个小时，也让我们看到了你进入联盟的决心。我们现在想要签下你，可是你的比赛经验太少，很难立即帮助球队，所以我考虑给你一份一年44万的非保障合同，并且赛季结束后成为了限制自由球员，这样作可以让球队下赛季拥有优先签约权，你能接受吗？”
一年底薪是没有保障的，只要在一月没有被裁掉，就可以自动变为保障合同。一旦被裁，前途未卜，风险很大。但换个角度想，如果可以打出漂亮的数据，下赛季就可以签一份比较大的合同。叶锋的想法很乐观，他不相信自己三个月时间还不能适应比赛节奏。至于限制自由球员这一项，他也可以接受，他还想在湖人拿冠军呢，怎么可能说走就走？他在办公室里看了一遍起草好的合同，痛快的完成了签约。
离开球馆，叶锋也不想加练了，他有种非凡的成就感，这么轻松就进入NBA，就算不能成为巨星，也将在篮球史上写下精彩的一页。
遗憾的是他无法代表中国国家队比赛。叶锋早知道自己拥有绿卡，但有绿卡不代表加入美国籍，只是一张永久居留证，证明一个外国人拥有在美国长期居住和工作的权利。所以，他还觉得自己是中国人。后来他上网查看新闻，却发现中国媒体爆出了他是美籍华裔的事实，虽然父母都是中国人，但他是在美国出生的。
各国的国籍法规不同，有的国家采用属地原则，孩子生在哪，就取得哪国籍；有的采用属人原则，依父母血统取得国籍；多数国家采用以上双原则，孩子在成年时可自己选择国籍。而美国实行的是出生地国籍政策。比如夫妻两个人都是没有美国国籍的留学生，却在美国生了一个小孩，这个小孩直接就是美国公民，叶锋遇到的就是这种情况。部分国家允许双国籍，中国却是不允许的。
所以，如果他想代表中国国家队打奥运会，世锦赛，除非加入中国国籍。很少有人这么干。申请加入中国国籍是很麻烦的。至少要满足以下条件，一是有中国人的近亲属，二是定居在中国。叶锋既然打NBA，怎么可能去中国定居呢？
由于没有加练，下午5点钟叶锋就回了家。一开屋门，发现加布瑞拉正铺着毯子，坐在地上练瑜伽呢，她只穿了运动背心和紧身裤，看起来非常性感。

搞什么？原来她的身材这么好，叶锋咽了口吐沫，平时加布瑞拉总是穿着宽松的T恤，给人邻家女孩儿的清新感觉，没想到穿了紧身衣，身材也是前凸后翘，玲珑有致。叶锋忽然想到了一个问题，教练总说他打球的动作太僵硬，身体柔韧性差，这样容易受伤。如果是锻炼练习瑜伽，是不是可以提高柔韧性呢？
他眼睛直勾勾的盯着加布瑞拉发呆，可把美女吓了一跳，赶紧站起来披上了一条毯子。叶锋意识到了自己的失态，也有点尴尬。
加布瑞拉红着脸问道：“你今天怎么这么早就回来了？”
叶锋从冰箱里拿了瓶冰水出来喝了几口，微笑道：“明天有比赛，为了保持体力，我没有加练投篮。原来你平时都练瑜伽？刚才我看到你在做高难度动作。”
加布瑞拉轻道：“嗯，我练过好几年了。”
叶锋笑道：“你的身体柔韧性很好，教练总是说我身体柔韧性差，打球容易受伤。我弯下腰双手都不能摸到地面，你能教我练习瑜伽的方法吗？或者告诉我看什么带子，我自己练也行，你偶尔给一点指导就好。”
加布瑞拉微微一愣，难道这就是他刚才看着我发呆的原因，而不是觉得我漂亮，这家伙是木头吗？女生爱美，美女往往是极度爱美，在英国小镇居住的时候，她是镇上的明星，有很多追求者，非常自信。和叶锋一起住以后，她都觉得自己信心有些受打击了。叶锋每天很早就出门，晚上九点钟以后才回来，一般和她打个招呼，说不了几句话就去洗澡，然后安静的看一会儿书就睡觉了。一起住了一段时间，他们都没有好好聊过一次天。
加布瑞拉对叶锋产生了好奇。难道我就对他没有半点吸引力？他连话都懒得和我说？他问道：“我可以教你，你想什么时候学？你每天都回来太晚了啊。”
叶锋想了想，说道：“赛季快开始了，我不会在再晚上加练，下午就能回来。研究说锻炼身体17－19点最好，你平时是这个时间吗？我可以回来和你一起练。”
加布瑞拉点了点头道：“可以，我一般就练一个小时，然后吃饭。你已经加盟湖人了？”
一说到这个，叶锋就红光满面。“嗯，今天我和球队正式签约了，只是一年底薪，不过我打篮球时间不长，能加盟湖人我就很知足了。我只会防守，进攻太差，他们也不可能和我签大合同。”
加布瑞拉对叶锋更好奇了。加布瑞拉很崇拜哥哥尼尔，觉得尼尔就是最强壮的人。可尼尔自认和叶锋没法比，还被他伤过，那叶锋到底得有多恐怖啊？她听表哥尼尔说过一些关于叶锋的事，知道他在橄榄球场上很强大。改行打篮球后，球迷们大都认为他一定会在季前赛结束后就被湖人放弃，可他竟然在季前赛开始前就签约了，这事儿太不可思议了。
“我如果想去看球的话，你能弄到球票吗？”加布瑞拉鬼使神差的问道，她忽然很想看看这个男人到底有什么本事？
“这个我不敢保证，等我问问再告诉你吧。”叶锋心想既然美女肯教他练瑜伽，表示谢意也是应该的。如果不能要到球票，他就自己花钱买套票送给加布瑞拉。他却不知道加布瑞拉对篮球根本就不了解，只是想看个热闹。他笑道：“我去洗澡了，你继续练？今天我回来的早，一起吃晚饭吧？住在一起这么长时间了，我们还没有好好聊过呢。”
“哦，好啊。”
起点中文网

Chapter 11 Basic Salary Signing
Even before he signed the contract, Ye Feng was already familiar with his teammates. Journalists are often good at observing people's actions and can say things that others like to hear. Ye Feng knows the preferences of several main players very well.
Fisher is a family man. He bought out his contract with the Jazz and returned to Los Angeles in order to treat his daughter's illness. When Ye Feng chats with him, he likes to talk about his family and treats him like a big brother. Fisher's skills are average, but he is the leader of the Lakers locker room. In addition, Fisher is also the chairman of the players union, and players across the league must give him face.
When chatting with Odom, he mostly talked about movies and Hollywood stars. Odom took the time to practice one-on-one with him and taught him some offensive methods, which benefited him a lot.
Radmanovic's hobby is skiing, and Ye Feng has also skied. The two had a very good chat about this, and they even agreed to go skiing together when they had time, but it would definitely not be the All-Star Weekend of the new season. Ye Feng remembered that Radmanovic was injured while skiing in his previous life, and was later suspended by the team, resulting in a loss of more than 500,000 US dollars. From then on, he was nicknamed "Skiing Man".
NBA newcomers have always had a glorious tradition of carrying bags and serving veteran players. Ye Feng was a rookie, a marginal player, and the youngest member of the team. He would not be so arrogant as to break this unspoken rule. He takes the initiative to be courteous without being reminded. He often took the initiative to pass towels, pour water, and do small things to please Fisher and Odom, two old teammates. Fisher and others also like him very much and treat him as a little brother.
The uniform team also noticed these things. The other newcomers are much shyer than Ye Feng. They respect the veteran players but don't know how to please them, and they fall behind compared to Ye Feng.
In addition to Bynum, who has long been familiar with them, four of the Lakers' starting players have a good relationship with Ye Feng. If these people are willing to put in a few nice words, Ye Feng believes that the possibility of getting a contract will greatly increase. He does not want to go back to UCLA to go to college.
The only person Ye Feng had no luck with was Kobe. Kobe's temper is not as bad as the media says, he is just a bit introverted and not good at words. He doesn't talk much to his teammates. He likes to get a massage and listen to music after practice, which is very quiet. Ye Feng wanted to say a few more words to Kobe, but he couldn't find a topic after much deliberation.
Kobe's mind is all about basketball. He won't show a false smile when getting along with others. He won't answer conversations when he encounters topics that he's not interested in. Maybe he will only say something if he is asked a question.
However, the lack of words does not mean that Kobe hates Ye Feng. After training one day, he stayed and practiced shooting for a while. Before leaving, he said to Ye Feng: "You can't make accurate mid-range shots in every position, so just practice one point in the high post. As long as you can hit mid-range shots in the high post, you will have an additional offensive method after the pick-and-roll."
Such words woke up Ye Feng. From that day on, he went from practicing shooting from all positions to only practicing high posts and free throws. This targeted practice method finally allowed him to make some progress.
The preseason will start tomorrow, and Laughlin informed Ye Feng to see general manager Kupchak and tell him it was big news.
Kupchak asked him to sit across from him and said with a smile: "Ye, you don't have an agent, so I talked to you directly. Several coaches evaluated your performance. You are very poor on the offensive end, but you are better on the defensive end and you are very hardworking. You stay for at least two hours of extra practice every day, which also allows us to see your progress. Determination to join the league. We want to sign you now, but you have too little game experience to help the team immediately, so I am considering giving you a one-year non-guaranteed contract of 440,000 and becoming a restricted free agent after the season. This will give the team priority to sign next season. Can you accept it?
The basic salary for one year is not guaranteed. As long as you are not laid off in January, it will automatically become guaranteed.contract. Once laid off, the future is uncertain and the risk is high. But think about it from another perspective, if you can produce good data, you can sign a relatively large contract next season. Ye Feng's thoughts are very optimistic. He doesn't believe that he can't adapt to the rhythm of the game in three months. As for the restriction of free agents, he can accept it. He still wants to win a championship with the Lakers. How can he just leave? He read the drafted contract in the office and completed the signing happily.
After leaving the gym, Ye Feng didn't want to practice any more. He had an extraordinary sense of accomplishment. He entered the NBA so easily. Even if he doesn't become a superstar, he will write a wonderful page in the history of basketball.
It's a pity that he can't play for the Chinese national team. Ye Feng had long known that he had a green card, but having a green card did not mean becoming an American citizen. It was just a permanent residence permit, proving that a foreigner had the right to live and work in the United States for a long time. Therefore, he still feels that he is Chinese. Later, he checked the news online and found that the Chinese media revealed the fact that he was Chinese-American. Although his parents were Chinese, he was born in the United States.
Nationality laws and regulations vary from country to country. Some countries adopt the territorial principle, which means that a child acquires nationality wherever he or she is born; some adopt the ratione persona principle, where nationality is acquired based on the blood of the parents; most countries adopt the above dual principle, and children can choose their own nationality when they reach adulthood. The United States implements a birthplace citizenship policy. For example, a husband and wife are both international students without U.S. citizenship, but they give birth to a child in the United States. This child is directly a U.S. citizen. This is the situation Ye Feng encountered. Some countries allow dual citizenship, but China does not.
Therefore, if he wants to represent the Chinese national team in the Olympics and World Championships, he must become a Chinese national. Very few people do this. Applying for Chinese citizenship is very troublesome. At least the following conditions must be met: first, having close relatives of Chinese nationals, and second, settling in China. Since Ye Feng plays in the NBA, how can he settle in China?
Since there was no extra practice, Ye Feng went home at 5 o'clock in the afternoon. When I opened the door, I found Gabriella sitting on the floor doing yoga with a blanket spread out. She only wore a sports tank top and leggings, and she looked very sexy.
What are you doing? It turned out that she had such a good figure, Ye Feng swallowed. Normally, Gabriella always wore loose T-shirts, giving people a fresh girl-next-door feel. Unexpectedly, she wore tights, and her figure was also curvy and slim. Ye Feng suddenly thought of a problem. The coach always said that his playing movements were too stiff and his body had poor flexibility, which made him prone to injury. If you practice yoga, can you improve your flexibility?
He stared straight at Gabriella in a daze, but the beauty was startled, and she quickly stood up and put on a blanket. Ye Feng realized his gaffe and was a little embarrassed.
Gabriella blushed and asked, "Why are you back so early today?"
Ye Feng took a bottle of ice water from the refrigerator and took a few sips. He smiled and said, "There is a game tomorrow. In order to maintain my strength, I did not practice shooting. So you usually do yoga? I just saw you doing difficult moves."
Gabriella said lightly: "Well, I have been practicing for several years."
Ye Feng smiled and said: "Your body is very flexible. The coach always says that my body flexibility is poor and I am prone to injuries when playing. I can't touch the ground with my hands when I bend down. Can you teach me how to practice yoga? Or tell me what straps to look at. I can do it myself. You can just give me some guidance occasionally."
Gabriella was slightly startled. Could this be the reason why he looked at me in a daze just now, instead of thinking that I was beautiful? Is this guy stupid? Girls love beauty, and beautiful women often love beauty extremely. When she lived in a small British town, she was a star in the town, had many suitors, and was very confident. After living with Ye Feng, she felt confidentSomewhat shocked. Ye Feng goes out very early every day and doesn't come back until after nine o'clock in the evening. He usually says hello to her, doesn't say a few words, goes to take a shower, and then reads quietly for a while before going to bed. After living together for a while, they never had a good chat.
Gabriella became curious about Ye Feng. Am I not attracted to him at all? He doesn't even bother to talk to me? He asked: "I can teach you, when do you want to learn? It's too late for you to come back every day."
Ye Feng thought for a while and said: "The season is about to start. I won't practice extra at night. I can come back in the afternoon. Research says that it is best to exercise between 17 and 19 o'clock. Is this your usual time? I can come back and practice with you."
Gabriella nodded and said, "Okay, I usually practice for an hour and then eat. Have you joined the Lakers?"
As soon as he mentioned this, Ye Feng's face lit up. "Well, today I officially signed a contract with the team. It's just a one-year basic salary. However, I haven't played basketball for a long time. I'm very satisfied if I can join the Lakers. I can only defend, but if my offense is too bad, they won't be able to sign a big contract with me."
Gabriella became even more curious about Ye Feng. Gabriella admires her brother Neil very much and thinks Neil is the strongest person. But Neil thinks he is incomparable to Ye Feng, and has even been injured by him. So how terrifying must Ye Feng be? She heard her cousin Neil say something about Ye Feng and knew that he was very powerful on the rugby field. After switching to basketball, most fans thought that he would be given up by the Lakers after the preseason, but he actually signed a contract before the preseason started. This is incredible.
"If I want to go to the game, can you get me a ticket?" Gabriella asked in a strange way. She suddenly wanted to see what this man was capable of?
"I can't guarantee this. I'll tell you after I ask." Ye Feng thought that since the beauty was willing to teach him yoga, he should express his gratitude. If he couldn't get the game tickets, he would spend his own money to buy a set of tickets for Gabriella. Little did he know that Gabriella didn't know much about basketball and just wanted to watch the fun. He smiled and said: "I went to take a shower, you continue to practice? I came back early today, let's have dinner together? We have lived together for such a long time, and we haven't had a good chat yet."
"Oh, okay."
